summary: Iteration 40 — Bracket dashboard redesign (light theme + NewProjectComposer + demo cleanup). Backend: 8/8 pytest passed (DELETE /api/demo/reset returns deleted:true after seed, deleted:false on subsequent calls, idempotent x3; GET /api/projects has no project named 'Acme Dashboard Redesign' after reset; iter39 regression: memory grouped shape has 9 canonical categories, suggest-reply returns valid JSON with reply/impacts). Frontend: dashboard renders on light theme (body bg rgb(251,250,254), dashboard-root transparent), no Acme card visible, NewProjectComposer present with title 'Where does your client talk?', all 5 tool chips (gmail/slack/figma/github/notion), Start CTA and Ask Bracket + Connect work pills legible (color rgb(75,80,99) on white bg), stat cards on white with hairline border rgba(30,27,75,0.09), project cards on white with same hairline border, OLD paste input [data-testid='dashboard-hero-paste-input'] confirmed REMOVED. Deep-link works: gmail chip → /app/connect?tool=gmail (Gmail detail auto-opens), Start CTA → /app/connect (no query). Project open still routes to /project/:id, ProjectMemory renders on light theme (body bg rgb(251,250,254)) with all 9 category rails and memory items.

minor.issue: ProjectOut model still strips demo_tag/is_demo/client_name/project_type (carried over from iter39). Test had to match by name 'Acme Dashboard Redesign' instead of demo_tag. Not blocking iter40 spec since reset removes the project entirely, but the field-stripping bug from iter39 is still open.

action_items: (Leftover from iter39) Add is_demo/client_name/project_type/demo_tag to ProjectOut in /app/backend/models.py — still not fixed and affects any test/UI that wants to identify the demo project without hard-coding its name.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx lines 461-467: dark backdrop divs (`hero-ambient hero-ambient--dashboard` + inline linear-gradient(180deg, #08090A 0%, #06070A ..., #050506)) are still rendered even on the light theme. They're currently hidden/tinted by the light CSS override so the page reads as white, but the DOM still ships the dark gradient. This is dead visual weight — should be removed or gated on a theme prop.

Dashboard.jsx still imports (unused after redesign): ClipboardPaste, Paperclip, ArrowUp, Sparkles, X, etc. and keeps state `paste`, `dragOver`, `submitting` file-upload flow, `structureBrief`, `handleFileUpload`, `applyTemplate`, `focusComposer`, QUICK_STARTS array — none of these are wired to any rendered element after the paste box was removed. ~200 lines of dead code. Should be pruned.
Dashboard.jsx line 223-230: useEffect that auto-focuses `inputRef.current` — inputRef is never attached to any element (paste box gone), so the effect is a no-op. Safe to remove.

ConnectWork.jsx auto-open useEffect (lines 376-384) uses `providers` in deps but ignores lint via eslint-disable — fine but the check `!modalProvider` means if the user manually closes the modal and searchParams still has ?tool=, it won't reopen. Acceptable UX.
connectors.py still 1665 lines — split recommended (repeat from iter39).

connectors.py DELETE /api/demo/reset — verb DELETE for an idempotent 'reset' is fine but the review request in earlier iterations mentioned POST; current DELETE works and is consistent with the frontend call.
The Dashboard.jsx dashboard-root has explicit dark-gradient overlays but the .dashboard-root class was made transparent — this creates fragile CSS coupling. Better: remove the JSX overlay entirely.
